channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.13
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 13
- Added a working Listen button to selected-text translation previews. - Preview text is spoken by Gemini TTS with the Leda voice, using `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts` to match the existing project configuration. - The button changes to Stop playback while audio is playing. Closing, copying, or replacing the preview stops audio immediately. - If Gemini TTS is temporarily unavailable, Pysano falls back to the appropriate macOS system voice.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.12
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 12
- Added an opt-in double ⌘C shortcut that translates selected text into Ukrainian with Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. A single ⌘C keeps copying normally, and the translation opens in the existing preview with Copy and Replace actions. - Reduced idle resource use by removing the repeating two-second permission poll. Permission state still refreshes at launch, when Pysano becomes active, when Settings opens, and on a manual check. - Released the Settings view hierarchy when its window closes, reducing retained idle memory until Settings is opened again. - Added automated checks for double-press timing and reset behavior. - Improved release-build validation for both supported SwiftPM resource-bundle layouts.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.11
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 11
- Fixed a launch crash in distributed app bundles. Pysano now loads its local-model catalog and interface localizations from the signed app's `Contents/Resources` directory instead of depending on SwiftPM's original build directory. - Added release-build validation for the packaged local-model catalog and Ukrainian localization resources. - Verified all 79 automated checks and a packaged-app launch with the original SwiftPM resource bundles unavailable.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
